StopCut is a Windows app for running a TigerStop saw stop from cut lists.

**Download:** get the `.zip` below, unzip it and run StopCut.exe. You don't need to install anything, and the app doesn't use the internet.

- Job cut lists from CSV, imported by hand or picked up automatically from a jobs folder
- A material library with kerf, end trim and minimum leftover for each material
- Cut plans per material or for the whole job, using leftovers first
- A NOW CUTTING panel showing the stick to use, the last cut and a drawing of the stick
- Leftover IDs (A1, B2...) to write on the pieces, plus a Leftovers list
- A safety spacer warning for short parts
- Recuts and extra parts while cutting, plus a Recuts log
- A Manual cut page with a touch number pad
- Connects to the TigerStop amp over RS-232 (a COM port)

StopCut is an independent product and is not affiliated with, sponsored, or endorsed by TigerStop, LLC. Use it at your own risk: see the license agreement shown the first time the app starts.
